name: Roof Drawing
description: Light openings, planters and drains, drawn in Rhino in mm on the 18 x 12 m plan. Unwired inputs keep the sample drawing, or the one in file.

inputParameters.name: file
inputParameters.description: A drawing.json. Optional; without it, the sample drawing.

inputParameters.name: openings
inputParameters.description: Closed curves: light openings, cut through the slab.

outputParameters.name: outlines
outputParameters.description: The openings and planters as the roof reads them, to check against your curves.
